meta.description: Frisch, Pierrehumbert and Broe's printed results for the consonants of Arabic verbal roots, counted in the 2,674 roots of Cowan (1979): the natural-classes similarity of every pair of consonants (Table III), observed and expected co-occurrence by similarity for adjacent and non-adjacent pairs (Table IV), the fits of five models of OCP-Place (Table V), and the three root types that illustrate the O/E measure (p. 185).

types.name: Consonant
types.doc: The consonants of matrix (8), in its column order.

levels.name: g
levels.label: g
levels.doc: ج, /dʒ/ in the standard language, which the paper writes as a dorsal stop

types.name: Distance
types.doc: The positions of a pair of consonants in a triliteral root.

levels.name: adjacent
levels.label: Adjacent
levels.doc: first and second, or second and third

types.name: SimilarityBin
types.doc: The similarity intervals of Table IV.

types.name: Model
types.doc: The models of OCP-Place compared in Table V.

levels.name: frequency
levels.label: Frequency
levels.doc: no OCP-Place effect: co-occurrence at random

levels.name: categorical
levels.label: Categorical
levels.doc: a categorical ban on consonants of one major class of (2)

levels.name: soft
levels.label: Soft Model
levels.doc: a categorical ban on adjacent identical consonants and a constant O/E for consonants of one major class

levels.name: feature
levels.label: Feature Model
levels.doc: O/E a decreasing function of similarity computed over the features of (8)

levels.name: naturalClasses

levels.doc: O/E a decreasing function of the natural-classes similarity

constants.name: lexiconRoots

columns.doc: The second consonant, not before the first in (8).

tables.doc: the observed and expected co-occurrence of the consonant pairs in a similarity interval.

tables.name: modelFits
